tagline: Field notes on AI short-form, music videos and tiny tools
description: A working journal from Omong Studio: how AI short-form episodes get made, how music videos are timed to the beat, and how one-file apps get shipped. Real pipelines, no hype.
about_blurb: Omong Studio is one creator and a small stack of AI tools. This journal is where the workflows get written down: what actually held a character together across nine episodes, which stage of a music video pipeline breaks first, and why a 90 KB HTML file beats a server nobody asked for. No case-study theatre, no inflated numbers — just the process, with the parts that failed still in it.
footer_note: Written and published by Omong Studio. No comment section, no newsletter pop-up — advertising and cookies are explained in the privacy policy.
